**Issue #3548 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3548: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E5, Tipsy, the Warhero Token, Refresh for Activates and Replenish
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds **Tipsy X**, the **Warhero Token**, **Refresh** for Activates (with every "Refresh N mana" renamed **Replenish**), and infinite mana.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP2, SP3, SP4, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## The designer's words

```text
* **Refresh**
  * Gives you back your non-**Refresh** giving activates again
  * E.g., if you **Refresh** an **Activate 4** you would get another **4 Activates**
  * Word in the way that makes the most sense
  * Existing “Refresh mana” instances now become “Replenish mana” to avoid confusion
* **Tipsy X**
  * A for fun drawback condition that takes the form of a player counter like Jade or Credits
    * Should be in a stein shape
  * While active, new cards played, summoned, or ones you draw may occasionally have a number or keyword or word in their name blurred on the client side
  * Chance scales with the X
  * Decays by 1 at the start of your turn
  * When it reaches 0, everything clears. Doesn’t clear from going from 2->1 though, just the odds of new things blurring goes down
  * Counter increases by X when playing a card with Tipsy X

* **Warhero Token (Stinkyscape Resource)**
  * At the beginning of the game, all Warhero tokens are worth 0 credits.
  * As soon as a single Warhero Token is printed, at the end of every turn, all Warhero tokens are worth 0-10 more credits.
    * Radiant versions are worth double whatever this counter is
  * They do nothing when played other than give credits.
  * Cost: (0)
  * Rarity: Rare
  * Flavor text: “Yeah, I’m a war hero.”
```

## The build (defaults from SP3; change one only with a ruling note)

- **Tipsy X**: a player counter like Jade or Credits, shown as a stein. Playing a card with Tipsy X adds X to it. It decays by 1 at the start of its owner's turn. While it is above 0, a card the player newly plays, summons or draws may have one number, keyword or word of its name blurred, with a chance that grows with the counter. At 0 every blur clears. Going from 2 to 1 clears nothing; it only lowers the odds for new cards (the designer). **Default:** only the Tipsy player's own view blurs. Which word blurs is decided by the engine in `view_for` from a hash of the game's seed and the card's instance, so it draws nothing from the game's `Rng` and a reload or a replay shows the same blur. The client renders the blur and never changes a rule (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The chance per card is `TIPSY_BLUR_CHANCE_PER_STACK`, capped by `TIPSY_BLUR_CHANCE_CAP` (config.rs).
- **Warhero Token** (a Stinkyscape Resource, Rare, (0), "Yeah, I'm a war hero."): every Warhero Token is worth one game-wide value in Credits. It starts at 0. Once any Warhero Token has been printed in the game, the value grows by a random 0 to 10 at the end of every turn (`WARHERO_GROWTH_MIN`/`MAX`, from the game's `Rng`). A Radiant one is worth double. "They do nothing when played other than give credits": playing one gives its value in Credits, and selling one at the Marketplace quotes the same value. Money Machine, #29 Grinder Veteran and #30 Yeah I'm a War Hero print them.
- **Refresh** (for Activates): "Gives you back your non-Refresh giving activates again … if you Refresh an Activate 4 you would get another 4 Activates." **Default:** Refresh resets this turn's uses of every Activate on your permanents, except Activates whose effect is a Refresh. #11 Energy Booster grants it when equipped.
- **Replenish**: every existing "Refresh N mana" / "Refresh your mana" wording becomes "Replenish …", with no change in behavior. Call to Chaos's "Refresh 2 mana" / "Refresh 4 mana" read as Replenish.
- **Infinite mana** (#56 Impact Reactor, "When awoken: Gain infinite mana"). **Default:** while the awakened Reactor is on its controller's field, that player's mana is not spent by paying costs, and the view shows ∞. It ends when the Reactor leaves the field.

## The cards that will use it

S01 (Rotten Grape's Tipsy 1, Money Machine's Warhero Tokens), S04 (#11 Energy Booster's Refresh), S10 (#56 Impact Reactor), S15 (#6.1 Fine Fermented Grape's Tipsy 2), S16 (#29 Grinder Veteran, #30 Yeah I'm a War Hero), S24 (Call to Chaos's Replenish).

## The rename

"Replenish" replaces the word only: catalog text, `card-text.yaml`, the Chinese terms (`chinese-terms.json`, `chinese.json`), the spec's §2 and §6 terms, the glossary, and every comment and test that quotes it. Behavior doesn't change, so the classifier reads it as wording. The Warhero Token is a catalog entry of its own (`stinkyscapeplus-t-warhero-token`, made by the foundation). The stein icon for Tipsy goes in the client's counter row beside Jade and Credits.

## Done when

- [ ] Each mechanic is written into the spec's sections it changes (§2, §3, §6, §10), with ruling notes numbered in this issue's block, tests named after them, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] Each is proved on fixture scripts in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` (the `testkit` feature's `scenario()`). A test proves the opponent's view never carries the Tipsy player's blur, and that a replay shows the same blur.
- [ ] The view (`view_for`) and the wire carry what it shows (`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` for any boundary it adds; `cargo test … --features jackioh-engine/ts` rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/`), and the client renders the stein, the blur, the Warhero value and ∞.
- [ ] Every prompt it opens is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. Every number is a named constant in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9). The engine stays pure (rule 4).
- [ ] No text says "Refresh … mana" any more, and `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `names --check`, `spec check` and `fuzz --seeds 200` pass.

Blocked by #3546

Part of #3534.
````
